newsitem.title: UK: Herzog to increase market-making on AIM and EASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Herzog to increase market-making on AIM and EASDAQ.

text.p: Equity market-making company Herzog Heine Geduld International said on Tuesday it planned to increase the number of stocks it traded on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market(AIM)and EASDAQ.

Herzog, a wholly owned subsidiary of Herzog Heine Geduld Inc based in New Jersey, said it was already making markets in 81 AIM and fully listed companies on the London Stock Exchange(LSE)but would increase its coverage to the majority of AIM issues.

There are currently over 280 companies listed on AIM and Herzog said it believed there was room for another specialist market-maker alongside established operations such as Winterflood Securities and Shore Capital Stockbrokers.
The company also makes markets in all eight EASDAQ issues and will extend its coverage as the number of companies listed on the pan-European exchange increases.
Herzog employs six market-makers on its London trading desk, with the team lead by Steve Burnham and Malcolm Stevenson, founders of the equity warrant trading firm Cresvale in 1979.
Stevenson said the London operation was currently concentrating on market-making and would be looking to create strong links with private client stockbrokers.
He said Herzog would eventually be looking to form an institutional broking service in London.
